The '''Bakuran Resistance''' was a resistance group that operated on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in response to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] invasion in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Due to Bakura's small population and the rather lenient occupation imposed by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]], the resistance movement on Bakura was small and consisted of about a hundred members.

Following the [[Ssi-ruu]]vi [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and the subsequent [[Bakura Truce|truce]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], members of the resistance cooperated with the Alliance. Under the leadership of [[Eppie Belden]], members of the resistance captured Nereus and overpowered his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] bodyguard during the [[Battle of Bakura]].
